content.text: This is not for print, I'm just wondering
Working on a story about how the trade went down. Trying to gather as much details as possible...I want to write a good story
Gotta go see your dad one sec
Ok... I figured you were one of the baseb██l ops guys waiting...any details you can provide, no matter how dumb, would be welcome.
Like how long did the process take, five minutes?
He just sign the waiver then leave? Did his dog answer the door? Was Kate there?
That kinda stuff...no worries if not. I'm not naming you guys in it
